O.outcome_detail: whether students are required to take a kindergarten entry assessment

result.effect: 11 attendance-mandating states require a KEA; no comparative effect size reported

cells.quote: This slow adoption is underscored by the fact that only 15 states and the District of Columbia mandate kindergarten attendance for all children within their jurisdictions. Of these, 11 still require that students take a KEA: Arkansas, Delaware, Hawaii, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Nevada, New Mexico, Ohio, South Carolina, and Virginia.
cells.note: This is a descriptive national policy scan based on publicly available information, not an experimental comparison; the study does not report a statistical comparison between attendance-mandating and non-mandating jurisdictions.
